## Summary

Add a wishlist so signed-in customers can save products for later and revisit them from a dedicated wishlist view.

## Acceptance Criteria

- Signed-in users can add or remove a product from a wishlist.
- Wishlist data persists through the API and database.
- The web app exposes a dedicated wishlist page or section.
- Product cards or product detail pages clearly show wishlist state.
- The implementation includes tests for the changed behavior.

## Notes for Demo

- This issue is intended for Demo 6b.
- The live GitHub issue created from this plan is issue #2 in the demo repository.
- Start with a local Plan session, then use Continue in Cloud.
- Keep the first implementation scoped: basic add/remove and display are enough.
